test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution casts an obligation on the State to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 45**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Right to education:

__
 
• **21A **The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of** six to fourteen years** in such manner as the State may, by law, determine.".
 
• Substitution of new article for** article 45**.- For article 45 of the Constitution, the following article shall be substituted, namely Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the **age of six years**
 
• The State shall endeavor to provide early childhood care and** education for all children **until they complete the** age of six years**.
 
• **Amendment of article 51A **- In article 51A of the Constitution, after clause (J), the following clause shall be added, namely:-"(k) who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the** age of six and fourteen years**.
